description: Strict contract for a Lightweight XR Content Engine content manifest (rev3 §2). Same pattern as dynamic ad insertion in online video (VAST/VMAP): pre-baked 3D layers bound to video-clock triggers. The XR client (Unity/OpenXR, Phase 1) parses this manifest, prefetches the State Bundles and switches layers on gestures. Gesture semantics are global and fixed by gestureDictionaryVersion (v1: Swipe_Right = next layer, swipe after last = dismiss all; Swipe_Left = previous; Palm_Hold ~0.8s = dismiss now; Pinch reserved) — they are NOT rebound per layer in v1.

gestureDictionaryVersion.description: Versioned gesture contract. MUST match GestureDictionary.Version compiled into the XR client — ManifestParser refuses to run on mismatch. Bumped only via manifest versioning (rev3 §2).

layers.description: Ordered layer stack. Budget ~10 layers per content item; beyond that the client's LRU eviction applies (rev3 §3).

bundleUrl.description: State Bundle URL. GLB with baked skeletal animations (Appear, Idle, React); geometry pre-compressed with Draco/meshopt and textures in KTX2/Basis Universal by the creator pipeline (rev3 §1).

layerId.description: Stable layer identifier, e.g. "layer_01". Referenced by cue actions (spawn | switch | despawn).

mode.description: v1: headLocked — object positioned in view space with a fixed offset, no dependency on CV (rev3 §4). phoneBody: v2 option — tracking the phone body as a static physical object for true 'above the screen' anchoring.

offset.description: Offset in metres, view space [x, y, z]. Example [0.0, 0.10, 0.60] ≈ 10 cm above the screen, 60 cm in front.

spawnAtMs.description: Video-clock trigger in milliseconds: when this layer spawns (state Appear -> Idle). Phase 1: informational / manual trigger; Phase 2: bound to the recognised video clock (rev3 §5).

videoId.description: Content binding. Scenario A: ID from the closed registry of registered content (not an arbitrary internet video). Scenario B: partner-supplied video ID (rev3 §5).

title: XR Layer Manifest — Spatial VAST/VMAP contract
